regime_context: The TSX detector shows a broad, two-tier leadership structure with Gold Miners and Silver & Royalties clearly ahead (scores ~1.6–1.8, breadth >0.9, durability 0.63–0.66), while the bottom half of the table is ineligible (negative scores, weak breadth) and heavily mean-reverting/trend-poor. The absolute-trend gate is validated for drawdown control on this market's history, so eligible-trend discipline is the one honest leg here; cross-sectional rank, crowding, and rotation timing carry no forward edge.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Gold Miners' durability_bar (0.66) falls below 0.5 OR breadth drops under 0.7 — that would signal the precious-metals leadership is thinning and the confirmed leader/challenger pair is losing internal cohesion; the watch retires if XGD.TO holds above its 20-day moving average AND breadth stays above 0.8 through the horizon.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners hold the strongest eligible-trend profile in the table: rank 1, score 1.8, the highest breadth of any theme (0.933), durability 0.66 above the 0.5 threshold, and no crowding flag (z 0.54). The trend-gate logic (the only validated edge) supports staying with an eligible, broad, non-crowded leader rather than trading against it. Momentum rank is treated purely as a focus lens, not alpha.
evidence: breadth 0.933 — leadership is broad-based, not a single-name spike
gate_helps == true for this market (drawdown control leg is live)
theses.dissent: Gold Miners is an inflation/geopolitical beta with mixed Hurst regime and near-zero r10 momentum (-0.0054); the leadership could be a coincident headline artifact (macro backdrop is 100% unscheduled surprise), and a mean-reversion snap in gold prices would hit the entire precious-metals complex at once.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO lags the S&P/TSX composite by 4% over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Silver & Royalties is the confirmed challenger in the rotation pair (score 1.627, margin to leader only 0.173) with breadth 0.917 and durability 0.63 — both above staying-power thresholds. It shares the same precious-metals trend-gate eligibility and non-crowded profile as Gold Miners. This is a companion tilt within the same eligible complex, not a distinct narrative call.
evidence: rotation margin 0.173 — challenger close to leader, but no confirmed handoff
theses.dissent: Silver & Royalties is the same precious-metals beta as Gold Miners under a different label; an overweight here is not diversification, it is doubled exposure to one macro factor (gold/silver prices, USD, geopolitics).

falsifier.text: XGD.TO breaks below its own 20-day moving average while Gold Miners (leader) stays above it for 5 consecutive sessions

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals & Copper is eligible (rank 3, score 1.308) with durability 0.51 — just above the trend-gate threshold — and breadth 0.667, which is meaningfully weaker than the precious metals but still positive. Hurst tag 'mean-revert' is a caution against expecting persistence, so this is a marginal stay-with-the-trend lean at best, justified only by the drawdown-control gate keeping the position in the eligible set.
evidence: gate_helps == true (risk-control leg is the only validated edge)
theses.dissent: Hurst tag 'mean-revert' directly contradicts a trend-following lean — copper/base metals are prone to sharp reversals on China demand headlines, and breadth 0.667 means leadership is only two-thirds of constituents, not a durable consensus.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO underperforms XGD.TO by 6% over any 10-day stretch before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
